concepts.name: LESSON 1.1 The Concept Of Democracy And
concepts.simple_definition: LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and democratization 1.1.1 Definition of democracy There is no absolute definition of democracy
concepts.deep_explanation: The term is elastic and expands and contracts according to the time, place and circumstances of its use
concepts.real_example: Practical example of LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and  from page 10.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and  with adjacent topics in Chapter 1.
concepts.name_amharic: LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and  (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and democratization 1.1.1 Definition of democracy There is no absolute definition of democracy (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The term is elastic and expands and contracts according to the time, place and circumstances of its use — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 10 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: "Demo" And "Kratos", Which Means People
concepts.simple_definition: The word democracy was derived from two Greek words: "Demo" and "Kratos", which means people and rule (legitimate power to rule), respectively
concepts.deep_explanation: In this case, the word democracy implies the idea of rule by the people or government by the people
concepts.real_example: Practical example of "Demo" and "Kratos", which means people  from page 11.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse "Demo" and "Kratos", which means people  with adjacent topics in Chapter 1.

concepts.simple_definition: LESSON 1.2 Definitions and actors of democratization process 1.2.1 The meaning of democratization Democratization is a complex, long-term, dynamic, and open-ended process
concepts.deep_explanation: It consists of progress towards a more rule-based, more consensual and more participatory type of politics

concepts.name: Civil Societies Like Political Parties,
concepts.simple_definition: Civil societies Like political parties, non-governmental associations and organizations are valuable vectors of democracy
concepts.deep_explanation: They differ from political parties only in their final goal, but they all contribute to consciousness raising, defense of the legitimate interests of groups of individuals and the protection of individual and collective rights and freedoms
